verdict.rationale: New Relic documents first-party ways to get data out. NerdGraph and NRQL query your data, `nr1 nrql` fetches data, and the CLI outputs JSON or YAML, so data can be retrieved in open formats. There is no evidence of a bulk or complete export feature, so 'export all data and leave' is only thinly supported through query-based retrieval. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, coverage of all data types (logs, traces, dashboards, alert configs), any OpenTelemetry or other open-format egress, and independent corroboration of migrating off.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data
nr1 nrql | Fetches data using NRQL.
--format string    output text format [JSON, Text, YAML] (default "JSON")
Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.
